Hydrogen ions (H⁺) are formed when an acid releases a proton, which happens when the acid dissolves in water and ionizes. For example, HCl → H⁺ + Cl⁻ in aqueous solution, and the H⁺ then associates with water as H₃O⁺. The question gives no answer options, so this is the standard textbook answer.
